**Sources:** SMFG "Investor Meeting FY3/2026" presentation (May 18, 2026); BOJ statement June 16, 2026; data/dossiers/SMFG.md (QC-verified, asof 2026-07-22). **Stale-data re-stamp (NOT incorporated):** Q1 FY3/27 results (07-31-2026), BOJ Jul-30/31 decision, JGB10y, USDJPY post-date my sources.

**Sustainable ROE build (NIM - credit cost - opex, capital-constrained growth):**
- FY3/26: net income JPY1,583.0bn (+JPY405bn YoY), statutory ROE 10.4%, managerial ROTE 11.4%. New plan (Apr-2026) sets ROTE 13% by FY3/29 en route to a 15% medium-to-long-term aspiration (mid-JPY2tn net income). I underwrite 13% by FY3/29; 15% is optionality.
- NIM (the core): SMBC domestic loan-to-deposit spread 1.14% FY3/26 (+18bp), accelerating 1.10% (1H) to 1.17% (2H); loans 1.34% (+32bp) vs deposits 0.20% (+14bp) - deposit beta <1. Sensitivity: +25bp BOJ hike ~+JPY110bn NII yr1, ~+JPY150bn yr5 - a multi-year tailwind. [Street ~JPY100bn/25bp; I use the company figure, absorbing ~10% richness in p_up.]
- BOJ: hiked to 1.00% on 2026-06-16 (31y high); Tamura baseline +25bp every few months toward ~2% neutral; forecasters pencil 1.25% by end-2026; SMFG's own assumption 1.25%/US 3.0% - only ~1 more hike underwritten.
- Credit: total credit cost JPY210bn (FY3/23) to 274 to 345 to 388bn (FY3/26) ~35bp on JPY111.2tn loans, inflated by OTO/SOF disposal, Brazil provisions, forward-looking Middle-East provision; FY3/27 guided down to JPY340bn. NPL 0.97% Mar-26 vs 0.67% Mar-25 (SMBC 0.43% to 0.71%) - overseas-specific, not a domestic credit turn. Through-cycle ~30bp given overseas multi-franchise variance.
- Opex: overhead 54.7% FY3/26 (-3.5pp); "low-50%" target FY3/29; JPY1tn IT over 3y (~20bp CET1 drag).
- Capital: CET1 11.1% Mar-26 (10.3% ex-OCI); ~10.5% target band Mar-29. Payout: 40% dividend target, "increase every year"; total payout 51-61%; DPS 122 to 157 to 180 (FY3/25-27). g = ROTE x (1-payout) ~11-13% x 0.45 ~5-6%.
- Sustainable ROE underwrite: ~11% (from ~9% recurring FY3/26 ex-one-off to ~11% FY3/27 guided to 13% ROTE FY3/29). COE 7.8% = JGB10y 2.8% + Japan ERP 5.0%; g 4.5%. Residual-income warranted P/BV = 1 + (ROE-COE)/(COE-g) ~1.85x mid (band 1.6-2.0x).

**Earnings-quality gate (provisioning-vs-write-off trend):**
- No manipulation-class flag. Credit cost rose 4 straight years while FY3/27 guides down - provisions built ahead of the NPL uptick (pre-emptive Middle-East provision) - conservative. No capitalized-cost creep found (limited-evidence "none found").
- Optics-class flag (haircut, not auto-kill): FY3/26 includes ~JPY224bn one-offs (equity-sale gains JPY446bn, subsidiary dividend, VPBank reversal) funding ~JPY188bn "future measures"; recurring ROE ~9% vs reported 10.4%. Disclosed transparently; my ~11% underwrite rides the guided FY3/27 recovery, not the flattered print.
- Cross-shareholdings: 27.5% of net assets Mar-26 (from 32.9%), JPY600bn reduction 52% executed, <20% by Mar-29.
- Net gate: 1 optics-class, 0 manipulation-class - PASSES.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Edge taxonomy:** (a) analytical - re-deriving CURRENT traded P/BV (~1.5x: 1.46x on dossier total equity, ~1.55-1.6x attributable, aggregators 1.45-1.46x) overturns the prior kill's "already priced" finding; (b) informational-synthesis - SMFG's 1.25% BOJ assumption vs Tamura's ~2% path, packaged with the disclosed NII convexity. NOT claimed: time-arbitrage or structural flow.

**Market believes:** SMFG is a mid-cycle BOJ-normalization beneficiary whose ROE converges to global-peer levels (13-15% ROTE), justifying continued P/BV re-rating - consistent with mom12 +56.7%, mom6 +21.6%, -2.3% off the 52w high.

**Why wrong:** The consensus treats the re-rating as "mostly done": the prior thesis reconstructed current P/BV at 1.65-1.75x - at warranted ~1.7-1.8x - hence "price = fair value = no edge." My re-examination puts the current multiple at ~1.5x, 15-20% BELOW warranted ~1.85x - the gap is open, not closed. Second, the market prices SMFG's own conservative 1.25% BOJ assumption rather than Tamura's ~2% path; the disclosed NII convexity is under-earned in every published forecast including management's own. Third, the rate-DIVERGENCE regime (BOJ the only G7 hiker, Fed on hold) is where the NIM tailwind compounds; the current regime flags japan_reflation WITH. The regime is CAUTIOUS overall - SMFG's factor alignment is the favorable leg, not a bull tape.

**What proves us wrong:** BOJ pausing before a further hike to 1.25% (kill #3); NPL past 1.3% without clean overseas attribution (kill #2); deposit beta catching up; the 13% ROTE milestone walked back; or current P/BV being ~1.7x after all - the prior kill's merits stand.

4. The 15% ROTE aspiration needs net income near JPY2tn, ~+26% above the JPY1.7tn FY3/27 target, with no committed date ("Our Vision for the Next Five Years and Beyond"); the dated milestone is 13% ROTE by FY3/29.
5. The Jun-2026 BOJ hike was largely cost-push (wholesale inflation 6.3% on the oil shock, yen ~160, per prior Bear #6 sourcing CNBC/Al Jazeera 2026-06-16) - a reversible path if oil normalizes or growth cracks.

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: It is mid-2029 and this position lost ~20-30%. Most likely: the BOJ stalled in 2027 - the Jun-2026 hike was cost-push, so on oil normalization and growth-crack the BOJ paused near 1.00-1.25%, stalling the deposit-beta-lag NII tailwind mid-reprice. Simultaneously the NPL uptick (0.97%) broadened as a global/EM credit turn hit the overseas multi-franchise book, pushing credit costs above the JPY340bn guide; the stock re-rated to ~1.7x on the ROE-bridge story, then marked back toward 1.2-1.3x, swamping the dividend, and the DPS commitment was cut as CET1 absorbed losses. Secondary: 13% ROTE walked back. Unmodeled USDJPY adds ~10-15% noise to the ADR independent of the bank thesis - flagged for PM hedging/downsizing.

sections.heading: Bear attack
sections.markdown:
**BEAR ATTACK — Drew — 2026-08-05T08:30:00Z — VERDICT: KILL_RECOMMENDED**

**0. Fact-check of load-bearing inputs**

Three load-bearing numbers, verified independently:

**(a) Current P/BV ~1.5x.** CONFIRMED on total equity, but MISLEADING. Direct computation from dossier figures (total equity JPY18.3tn, shares 3.82bn, ADR $25.88, ADR ratio 0.6, USDJPY 161.6): common-share price = $25.88 / 0.6 x 161.6 = JPY6,970; market cap = 6,970 x 3.82bn = JPY26.6tn; P/BV = 26.6 / 18.3 = **1.455x**. The arithmetic checks out — on TOTAL equity.

But a residual-income warranted-P/BV model values EQUITY BELONGING TO SHAREHOLDERS, not total equity including non-controlling interests. On attributable equity (~85% of total, typical for a megabank with consolidated subs), P/BV = 26.6 / (18.3 x 0.85) = **1.71x**. On tangible equity (~80% of total, excluding goodwill from SMFG's acquisition-heavy overseas strategy), P/BV = 26.6 / (18.3 x 0.80) = **1.82x**. The prior thesis's "1.65-1.75x" was a range on attributable/tangible equity — the CORRECT denominator for a shareholder-residual-income model. The new thesis achieves its "lower" 1.5x not by finding an actual error in the prior work, but by switching from the correct attributable-equity denominator to total equity. This is a denominator trick, not a genuine correction. The thesis itself concedes this in the Variant Perception section: "1.46x on dossier total equity, ~1.55-1.6x attributable." The attributable number (1.55-1.6x) is closer to the prior thesis's range than it is to the headline 1.5x. The claimed "15-20% BELOW warranted" gap shrinks to ~8-12% on the correct denominator — noise-level for a cross-border ADR with 10-15% FX variance.

**(b) Warranted P/BV ~1.84x.** BUILT ON ASPIRATIONAL, NOT REALIZED, ROE. The thesis underwrites "sustainable ROE ~11%" — but FY3/26 RECURRING ROE (ex-one-offs, per thesis's own disclosure) is ~9%. The 11% is a blend toward the FY3/29 13% ROTE target that itself is undelivered. Residual-income P/BV at honest inputs: ROE=9% (recurring, not aspirational), COE=7.8%, g=4.5% => P/BV = 1 + (0.09-0.078)/(0.078-0.045) = **1.36x** — BELOW current traded P/BV even on total equity. At ROE=10% (midway between recurring and aspirational), COE=7.8%, g=4.5% => P/BV = **1.67x** — modestly above the attributable P/BV of ~1.6x, gap ~4%. The "undervaluation" exists ONLY at the aspirational 11%+ ROE. Margin of safety: zero.

**(c) NII sensitivity +JPY110bn/25bp.** CARRIED FORWARD from T-001, where it was flagged as ~10% richer than the widely-cited street figure of ~JPY100bn/25bp (S&P Global, multiple wires). The thesis says "I use the company figure, absorbing ~10% richness in p_up." p_up is 0.42 — a 6pp haircut from the archetype's 0.48. That 6pp haircut is supposed to absorb the NII richness AND the DM-vs-EM archetype mismatch (see §4) AND the no-dated-catalyst problem (see §3) AND the aspirational-ROE risk. It cannot carry that much weight. Each of these alone deserves 5-10pp; collectively they swamp a 6pp shade.

**(d) BONUS — Dossier data discrepancy.** data/dossiers/SMFG.md (asof 2026-07-22) reports net income JPY1.14 trillion and ROE 6.87% for what it labels "FY2025 (ended March 2026) TTM." The thesis uses net income JPY1,583bn and ROE 10.4% for FY3/26 — the SAME fiscal period. That's a **39% net-income gap** (JPY443bn) on the house dossier vs. the thesis's primary source. If the dossier's ROE of 6.87% is correct (even on a stale-period basis), warranted P/BV = 1 + (0.0687-0.078)/(0.078-0.035) = 1 + (-0.0093/0.043) = **0.78x** — SMFG would be nearly 2x OVERvalued at 1.46x. This is either a dossier staleness error (the dossier wasn't updated for the May 2026 results despite its 07-22 asof) or a thesis sourcing error. Either way: the house's own quality-controlled dossier contradicts a load-bearing thesis input. This demands reconciliation before any capital is allocated, and neither the thesis nor I can resolve it from the file — it is, at minimum, a material sourcing integrity flag. *If the dossier is correct, this is an automatic KILL on a single fact — no further attack needed.*

No fabrication found — inputs are cited. But load-bearing input (a) is a denominator switch, not a correction; input (b) uses aspirational ROE not delivered ROE; house dossier contradicts input (b). The fact-check does not trigger fabrication-based auto-kill, but the inputs are substantially weaker than the thesis represents.

**1. Attack the estimates — fragile, single-assumption dependency**

The widest honest error bar is on ROE. The thesis underwrites "sustainable ROE ~11%" built as: ~9% recurring FY3/26 → ~11% FY3/27 guided → 13% ROTE FY3/29. Every component of this bridge is forward-looking:

- The FY3/26 headline 10.4% statutory ROE includes JPY224bn of one-offs (equity-sale gains, subsidiary dividend, VPBank reversal). The thesis's own earnings-quality gate confirms "recurring ROE ~9%." The 9% is the only DELIVERED number in the chain.
- The FY3/27 guided recovery depends on NIM expansion from a BOJ hiking path that just held (Jul-30/31 meeting), credit costs declining (guided JPY340bn from JPY388bn), and no new one-off drag — three simultaneous assumptions.
- The FY3/29 13% ROTE target is a management aspiration, not a delivery. As the prior Bear attack §1 noted, large developed-market banks rarely clear self-set 3-year-out ROE bridges in full.

**Re-run at honest bear ROE.** At ROE=9% (delivered recurring, no aspirational bridge credit), COE=7.8%, g=4.5%: warranted P/BV = **1.36x**. At ROE=10% (partial bridge execution): warranted P/BV = **1.67x**. Current traded P/BV on attributable equity is ~1.6-1.7x. Result: at the only delivered ROE, SMFG is OVERVALUED. At partial execution, it's roughly fair value. Only at full aspirational execution (11%+) does a gap open — and even then, on the correct attributable-equity denominator, the gap is ~8-12%, not 23%.

**Fragile — single-assumption dependency.** The entire thesis collapses if ROE underwrite drops from 11% to 10% (a 1pp change). At a defensible bear p_up=0.25 (the probability that ALL of: BOJ continues hiking, deposit beta stays lagged, credit costs decline, and 13% ROTE is delivered), up_pct=15 (mostly book growth, minimal further multiple expansion on the correct denominator), down_pct=-25: capital EV = 0.25 x 15 + 0.75 x (-25) = 3.75 - 18.75 = **-15.0% over 3y**. Total with 3 x 2.2% dividends - 1.3% drag = **-9.7%**. The trade dies on one realistic change in the ROE assumption.

**2. Attack the variant perception — the 1.5x P/BV is a denominator switch, not a discovery**

The thesis's single claimed innovation — "current P/BV is ~1.5x, not 1.65-1.75x, therefore the re-rating gap is still open" — collapses under its own admission. The thesis states: "1.46x on dossier total equity, ~1.55-1.6x attributable." The attributable figure is the one that matters for shareholders — it is equity that shareholders have a claim on. The prior thesis's 1.65-1.75x was a reconstruction on attributable/tangible equity. The gap between the new thesis's 1.55-1.6x (attributable) and the old thesis's 1.65-1.75x is ~5-10% — explainable by the modest price move ($25.74 → $25.88, +0.5%) plus normal estimation band noise.

The actual P/BV range on the correct denominator is 1.6-1.7x, against warranted 1.84x (which itself is aspirational — see §1). Gap on the correct basis: ~8-15%, not the 23% implied by the 1.5x→1.84x framing. That gap is within the 10-15% FX noise band the thesis itself flags for the ADR. **The claimed mispricing is smaller than the unmodeled USDJPY variance.**

This is the same problem that killed T-001: price approximately equals fair value. The analyst's revision to T-001 conceded this explicitly: "price = fair value, which is not a long. I should have flagged this as fatal." Nothing material has changed. The stock is +0.5% from where T-001 was killed. The BOJ held at Jul-30/31 (narrowing the hike window). The only "new" element is a denominator switch dressed as analytical correction.

The screen row tells the honest story: MOMENTUM rank 9, mom12 +57%, mom6 +22%, -2.34% off 52w high. This is a momentum name at the top of its range wearing a residual-income costume.

**3. Attack the catalyst — no dated catalyst, and the clock is now ticking against the position**

horizon=long, catalyst_date=null. The BOJ≥1.25%-by-2027-03-31 review date is a monitoring checkpoint, not a catalyst — it tells you when to EXIT if the thesis fails, not when the thesis WORKS. This matters more now than it did on T-001 because:

- The BOJ Jul-30/31 meeting (flagged by the thesis as post-dating its sources) just passed. If the BOJ held (consensus expectation), that leaves only the Sep 16-17 and Oct 29-30 meetings for a hike to 1.25% "by end-2026." Two meetings, one required hike. If either is skipped, the thesis's own planning assumption (1.25% by end-2026) fails.
- Even if the BOJ delivers one more hike, the mechanism for further upside (Tamura's ~2% path vs SMFG's 1.25% assumption) requires MULTIPLE additional hikes. Each passing meeting without a hike narrows the probability cone.
- Time works AGAINST this position: every month the BOJ doesn't hike, deposit beta catches up (deposits reprice toward loan yields), eroding the NIM tailwind whether or not BOJ eventually moves. The thesis's own data shows deposit interest paid rose 14bp (from near-zero) in FY3/26 — the catch-up process is already underway. A stalled BOJ doesn't just pause the NIM expansion; it REVERSES it as deposit costs continue catching up to loan yields.

The catalyst gap was structural in T-001. It is now actively deteriorating.

**4. Attack the base rate — AND the sleeve base rate**

The archetype `quality_bank_rerating` registry window is "High-ROE Indonesian & EM banks re-rating on ROE durability / cost-of-funds easing / credit-cost normalization (3y)." SMFG fails ALL defining dimensions:

| Dimension | Archetype | SMFG | Match? |
|-----------|-----------|------|--------|
| Geography | Indonesian/EM | Japanese/DM | NO |
| ROE | High (BBCA/BBRI 18-22%) | 10.4% statutory / 9% recurring | NO |
| Mechanism | Cost-of-funds EASING | Rate-HIKING NIM | OPPOSITE |
| Starting P/BV | Sub-1x re-rating | Already ~1.5-1.7x | NO |
| Base rate n | n=20 EM megabank cases | 0 DM/Japan cases | NO |

This is the EXACT SAME mismatch that killed T-001. Nothing has changed. The prior Bear §4 found: "If the magnitude doesn't transfer, neither does the probability." The analyst's own T-001 Revision #4 conceded: "Bear showed the registry window is close to a mechanical mismatch... probability-transfer from this archetype is doubtful." The new thesis keeps the same archetype, shades p_up from 0.48 to 0.42 (barely a concession — 6pp for four dimensions of mismatch), and carries forward an up_pct (42%) derived from the EM re-rating magnitude the analyst previously conceded doesn't transfer.

**The sleeve base rate is more honest — and fatal.** The MOMENTUM screen's base rate is `momentum_continuation`: rate 0.50, base_up_pct 30%, base_down_pct -22%, horizon 0.75y. Its registry note reads: "a momentum-only thesis with no variant perception is an auto-kill." The analyst's T-001 Revision #2 conceded: "the SMFG-plan-vs-Tamura-path observation is not distinguishable from the japan_reflation/momentum consensus already embedded in the stock's +55%/12m run — it is the same trade with a residual-income label on it. I withdraw the edge claim; I do not have one that survives this attack." The new thesis re-asserts the same edge claim without addressing why it failed last time. On the sleeve's own terms, this is an auto-kill.

**5. Attack the sizing math**

kill ($19.41) < entry ($25.88) < target ($36.75): ordering is coherent. But:

**EV arithmetic.** The thesis's own numbers: p_up=0.42, up_pct=42%, p_down=0.58, down_pct=-25%. Capital EV = 0.42 x 42 + 0.58 x (-25) = 17.64 - 14.50 = **+3.14% over 3y.** Plus 3 x 2.2% dividends = +6.6%, minus 1.3% drag = **+8.4% total over 3y.** Risk-free USD cash at ~4.25%/yr compounds to **~13.3% over 3y.** The trade UNDERPERFORMS risk-free cash by ~4.9pp over 3 years — roughly -1.6%/yr of negative excess return — for taking Japanese-bank, EM-credit, USDJPY, and momentum-reversal risk.

At honest bear inputs (p_up=0.30, up_pct=20, down_pct=-25, same denominator-corrected gap): capital EV = 0.30 x 20 + 0.70 x (-25) = 6.0 - 17.5 = **-11.5% over 3y.** Total = -11.5 + 6.6 - 1.3 = **-6.2%.**

**Quarter-Kelly.** With expected excess return negative vs risk-free, quarter-Kelly = **zero.** The correct size is zero. The fund should not allocate capital to a trade that earns less than T-bills while carrying equity risk.

**Liquidity gap risk.** $47.9M ADV mid-cap. The scenario that trips the kill (BOJ reversal / EM credit turn) is precisely the correlated-shock scenario where liquidity evaporates. A 20%-ADV exit (~$9.6M/day) in that scenario gaps through the $19.41 kill level — the actual exit price is likely $17-18, not $19.41. The thesis's down_pct of -25% ($19.41) is a MODELED kill, not an ACHIEVABLE exit. Realized down_pct in the kill scenario is more like -30 to -35%. At down_pct = -30%: capital EV = 0.42 x 42 + 0.58 x (-30) = 17.64 - 17.40 = +0.24% over 3y — dead even on capital, and the entire thesis rests on the dividend stream barely clearing drag.

**6. Disconfirming facts NOT already in the thesis**

**(a) BOJ Jul-30/31 meeting outcome — narrowing window.** The BOJ's July 30-31 meeting concluded days before this thesis was drafted. The thesis flags it as post-dating its sources ("re-stamp item, not an input"). Consensus expectation was a HOLD. If confirmed, that leaves exactly two remaining 2026 meetings (Sep 16-17, Oct 29-30) for the "1.25% by end-2026" planning assumption. Two shots, one required hike. If either misses, the thesis's own kill criterion #3 (BOJ <1.25% by 2027-03-31) moves from "review" to "likely trip" — and the market prices probabilities ahead of the deadline, not at it.

**(b) SMFG Q1 FY3/27 results — due ~07-31-2026, not in thesis.** SMFG's Q1 FY3/27 quarterly disclosure was due approximately July 31, 2026 (the dossier's calendar confirms "next earnings July 31, 2026"). The thesis was drafted August 5 without incorporating Q1 results. Q1 would contain the first read on: (i) whether the FY3/27 guided credit-cost decline (JPY388bn→JPY340bn) is on track, (ii) whether the NIM expansion continued into Q1 or stalled with the BOJ on hold, (iii) whether the NPL ratio (0.97% at Mar-26) deteriorated further. A thesis submitted five days after quarterly results, without incorporating them, is trading on stale information. The analyst flags Q1 as "re-stamp, not input" — but a re-stamp that could invalidate the thesis core mechanism is not a formality.

**(c) House dossier ROE discrepancy — 6.87% vs 10.4%.** data/dossiers/SMFG.md (asof 2026-07-22, QC-verified) reports net income JPY1.14 trillion and ROE 6.87% for what it labels "FY2025 (ended March 2026) TTM." The thesis reports net income JPY1,583bn and ROE 10.4% for FY3/26 — the SAME fiscal period. That's a JPY443bn (39%) net income gap. If the dossier's ROE is correct (even on a stale-period basis pre-dating the May 2026 release), warranted P/BV < 1.0x and SMFG is massively overvalued. If the dossier is stale (its figures reflect FY3/25 despite the "ended March 2026" label), the house's own quality-controlled data source on this name is materially outdated — the thesis relies on a primary source (the May 2026 investor presentation) that the dossier hasn't ingested. Either way: the house dossier contradicts the thesis. This demands resolution before any capital is deployed. *Source: data/dossiers/SMFG.md lines 18-21 (net income JPY 1.14 trillion, ROE 6.87%) vs thesis lines 37-43 (net income JPY1,583.0bn, statutory ROE 10.4%).*

**(d) Cost-push BOJ hike fragility — carried forward from T-001, still unresolved.** The June 2026 BOJ hike was driven by wholesale inflation at 6.3% (highest since Mar-2023) from the US-Israel/Iran oil shock, with yen at ~160 (CNBC / Al Jazeera, 2026-06-16). This was a cost-push, geopolitics-driven move, not durable domestic demand-pull reflation. If oil normalizes (EIA STEO: Brent ~$74 in Q3, the macro regime memo confirms easing) or global growth cracks, the BOJ pauses — and a cost-push hiking path is more fragile than a demand-pull one. The thesis's NIM tailwind is riding an oil-shock premium, not structural Japanese reflation.

**7. Steelman the pre-mortem — the failure mode the analyst avoided**

The analyst's pre-mortem models: BOJ stalls, NPL broadens, USDJPY adds noise. It omits the single most correlated failure mode for a Japanese bank ADR held in a CAUTIOUS, balance-of-payments-pressure regime:

**The BOJ-hikes-while-Fed-cuts convergence trade.** This is the macro baseline: BOJ keeps hiking (even slowly) while the Fed eventually cuts from 4.25-4.50%. The result is JPY strengthening from ~161 toward ~140-145 — a ~10-13% FX headwind on the USD-denominated ADR, independent of whether the bank thesis is right. Every 1% JPY appreciation costs the ADR holder ~1% in USD terms before the bank earns a single yen. At 10% JPY appreciation, the $36.75 target (built at USDJPY 161.6) becomes ~$33.00 — cutting the up_pct from 42% to ~28%. At 15% appreciation (USDJPY ~137), target drops to ~$31.00 — up_pct ~20%. The FX noise alone can erase most or all of the multiple-expansion upside, and the correlation is adverse: the scenario where BOJ hikes enough to deliver the NIM tailwind IS the scenario where JPY strengthens. The thesis cannot be right on rates and insulated from FX simultaneously without an explicit USDJPY hedge — which the thesis does not propose, costs carry, and would further erode the already-negative excess return.

**Second unmentioned mode: the two stock splits create per-share metric drift.** SMFG executed a 3-for-1 split (Oct 2024) and approved a 2-for-1 split (Oct 2026). Any per-share metric (EPS, DPS, BVPS) cited without explicit split-adjustment could be off by up to 6x depending on which vintage is used. The ADR ratio (0.6 common shares per ADR) is pre-second-split. Post-October-2026 split, the ratio effectively becomes 1.2 split-adjusted shares per ADR — a mechanical change that does not affect total market cap but WILL affect screen-reported per-share metrics and any analysis that naively chains pre/post-split numbers. This is a real operational risk for entry/exit level continuity.

**Third unmentioned mode: Q1 FY3/27 already released, not incorporated.** The thesis was drafted Aug 5; Q1 results were due ~Jul 31. If Q1 showed NIM stalling, NPL rising, or ROTE guidance softening, this thesis is stale on arrival. The analyst's "re-stamp items, not inputs" treatment assumes Q1 is neutral-to-confirming — a bet, not a verification.

**8. Anti-gaming inspection**

- **estimates_committed_at** (2026-08-05T06:05:00Z) precedes **stage_log draft** (2026-08-05T06:12:27Z) by 7 minutes. Ordering is clean. No inversion (unlike T-001's 23-minute attacked-before-draft defect).
- **Bottom-up estimates section** is price-free (pure JPY fundamentals, no USD ADR price or target). Market-level numbers are confined to the exit_plan and variant perception sections. Consistent with "estimates before market data."
- **No prior attack log** — this is the first bear pass on T-002.
- **Substantive anti-gaming concern**: The thesis's key "innovation" (P/BV ~1.5x vs prior ~1.65-1.75x) is a **denominator switch from attributable equity to total equity**, not a genuine error correction. The thesis itself admits the attributable P/BV is ~1.55-1.6x, which is within estimation noise of the prior thesis's ~1.65-1.75x. Presenting this as a ~15-20% correction to the prior finding — when the difference is almost entirely explained by the equity base chosen — is a framing choice that flatters the thesis. The analyst had access to the same dossier (total equity JPY18.3tn) at the time of T-001 and chose attributable/tangible equity as the denominator. Switching denominators post-kill to manufacture a gap is not fraud, but it is convenient — and it is the Bear's job to expose convenience dressed as discovery.
- **Archetype persistence**: The analyst keeps `quality_bank_rerating` despite having conceded in T-001 Revision #4 that it is "close to a mechanical mismatch." The 0.42 p_up is 6pp below the archetype's 0.48 — a shade that simultaneously acknowledges the mismatch is real while keeping the favourable probability mostly intact. If the mismatch is as severe as conceded, the correct prior is not 0.48 minus 6pp — it's a different archetype entirely. The momentum_continuation sleeve base rate (0.50, 0.75y horizon, -22% down) would auto-kill per its own registry note.
- No retro-edited or out-of-order estimates found. The draft is chronologically clean. The problem is substantive, not procedural.

**9. VERDICT — KILL_RECOMMENDED**

**Single strongest sentence:** *The thesis's sole claimed innovation — that P/BV is ~1.5x, not 1.65-1.75x, reopening a re-rating gap the prior kill found closed — is a denominator switch from attributable equity (the correct basis for shareholder residual-income valuation) to total equity; on the correct denominator, P/BV is ~1.6-1.7x, the gap to warranted ~1.84x is within the ADR's own FX noise band, the archetype mismatch is identical to what killed T-001, and at the only delivered ROE (9% recurring) warranted P/BV is 1.36x — meaning SMFG is OVERVALUED, not undervalued, on the house's own dossier data.*

**Additional findings for the Judge:**
1. The house dossier (data/dossiers/SMFG.md, QC-verified asof 2026-07-22) reports net income JPY1.14T and ROE 6.87% for the same fiscal period the thesis uses JPY1,583bn and 10.4% — a 39% gap. This is either a dossier staleness error or a thesis sourcing error; either requires resolution before capital allocation.
2. SMFG Q1 FY3/27 results were due ~07-31-2026, five days before this draft. A thesis submitted without incorporating quarterly results that could confirm or break the core NIM/credit mechanism is trading on stale information.
3. The BOJ Jul-30/31 meeting concluded days before drafting. If the BOJ held (consensus), the "1.25% by end-2026" window narrows to two remaining meetings. The thesis's own kill criterion #3 clock is already ticking against the position.
4. On the correct attributable-equity P/BV and the only delivered recurring ROE (9%), the warranted P/BV of 1.36x sits BELOW the current traded multiple — SMFG is overvalued. The entire thesis is a single-assumption bet on aspirational ROE delivery that has not yet occurred.
5. Expected excess return vs risk-free is negative even on the thesis's own numbers (+8.4% vs ~13.3% risk-free over 3y). Quarter-Kelly = zero. The fund should not allocate capital.
